profile.headline: Sr Solutions Architect - AI Platform @ T-Mobile
profile.summary:
My passion for technology is the driving force behind my work as a Software Developer. With a sharp attention to detail and a diverse set of skills, I am committed to delivering exceptional solutions that meet and exceed expectations.

I take great pride in my work, always striving to go above and beyond to ensure that every project I work on is a success. I thrive on challenges and am constantly seeking out new opportunities to learn and grow. Whether it's through personal side projects or professional development initiatives, I am always expanding my skill set and staying at the forefront of the industry.

Outside of work, you'll often find me tinkering with various hardware and software projects, constantly pushing the boundaries of what's possible. With a strong foundation in Software Development and a Deep Understanding of technology, I am well-equipped to take on any challenge and deliver results that make a real impact.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: As a Senior Software Engineer for T-Mobile's Digital AI group, I am a key member of the Voice ASR Platform team. My achievements include developing Java Microservices for a more streamlined workflow, successfully deploying Voice Transcription servers, implementing hardware optimization strategies resulting in cost savings of over $2.5 million, mentoring junior team members, and collaborating with the Data Science team for successful model deployments. My contributions have been critical to the team's success in delivering high-quality products and improving the overall user experience.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Identity and Access Management
positions.description: Worked as a Software Engineer for JP Morgan Chase, specifically within the Identity and Access Management organization of the company. I am part of a team which deals with various types of operations for secrets management. The projects that I have worked on in this space are primarily RESTful APIs written in Java using the Springboot framework with PL/SQL and MySQL as the data stores. Additionally there are agents which need to be installed on hosts, this is automated via Ansible, and supports both Linux and Windows hosts. All of the projects are fully CI/CD, managed individually by the development team, utilizing Jenkins as the build server. I also have been given the responsibility to interview potential candidates for our department.

positions.title: Software Developer - Object Oriented
positions.description: Worked as a Software Developer for State Farm Bank. I was part of an amazing team which provides enhancements to an existing vehicle loan underwriting engine. The part of the product I work with contains Java, PL/SQL, Adobe Coldfusion and more. My current work require me to work all parts of the stack.

positions.title: Intern Developer
positions.description: Worked as an Intern Developer for UTS Warranty. The company had a web presence for its technician, but wanted to expand to a mobile for ease of access. I was hired to write the Android Application which allowed technicians to easily access customer information on the go. Application was written in Java, utilized XML for UI, and mySQL as the DBMS.

educations.schoolName: The University of Texas at Dallas

projects.title: Auto Off
projects.description: Auto Off helps the user conserve battery by disabling Wifi/Bluetooth when not in use. The user sets up a specified timeout, once the device is disconnected from the network and the timeout period occurs, the wifi radio is disabled. This functions similarly for bluetooth devices.

projects.title: Home Automation
projects.description: Currently using an open source python based home automation server to automate my home. Home Assistant (https://home-assistant.io/) is a wonderful tool to get started with bridging the gaps between current day home automation hubs/devices. I have configured our setup at home to meet the needs of the family; this consists of monitoring of temperature, motion, state of devices in order to perform the appropriate action, such as sending a notification. This setup even allows control via Google Home and Amazon Echo. I have utilized linux to stand up the server and python to configure this platform.
